full_script: [warm] Llevas a tu mascota al veterinario. Di cada frase en inglés antes que yo. My dog is sick. He's three years old. My cat throws up a lot. Ahora, nivel intermedio. He won't eat anything. Is he due for any shots? How often should I give him the pill? I think he ate something bad. Y ahora, nivel experto. He's limping. He needs to be neutered. He's shedding a lot. Con tres, básico. Con siete, intermedio. Y si te sabías las diez, tu mascota tiene un experto en casa. [cheerful] ¿Cómo se llama tu mascota? Dímelo con tu número en los comentarios.
